[D1:1] Maria: Hey John! Long time no see! What's up?

[D1:12] John: It enabled needed repairs and renovations, making the learning environment safer and more modern for students.
[D1:13] Maria: Wow John, it really made a difference for schools and students! It must have been great to be involved. What's your next move in politics?

[D2:19] Maria: Definitely, John. They bring us joy, support, and a feeling of being part of something special. We should cherish every moment with them.

[D2:23] Maria: Yeah, John! It definitely builds a strong bond. Those shared meals really make life enjoyable and meaningful. What did you make?
